thesis: Research should advance through evidence gates, accountable AI roles and reusable intellectual dossiers.
role: Define collaboration, novelty and stopping criteria.

ideas.statement: AI can propose and check candidates, but independent evaluation requires distinct methods and evidence access, while humans retain responsibility.
Research dossiers retain premises, rejected alternatives and failure conditions as sufficient memory for responsible continuation.
Originality requires a new result beyond assembling existing concepts, and untransferred or cost-erased advantages require narrowing the program.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Progress begins with agreed operational contracts rather than shared metaphysics, then moves from discrete mechanisms to interventions and language.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
